PrincipalIdentity is the stable authenticated subject/service identity owned by PIAC. AuthSession is authentication/session evidence only and never equals JourneySession, DeliverySession or RuntimeExecutionSession. ActorContext is a minimized projection containing principal, validated session context, tenant memberships/scopes, assurance/authentication context where available and policy/version refs. ResourceRef and SubjectRef are typed owner-lane references. PurposeRef is mandatory for sensitive reads/writes. ConsentDecisionRef, EntitlementDecisionRef and AccessDecisionRef bind current policy/version/effective/expiry/revocation/evidence. Correlation/causation IDs are security/trace metadata, not authority.

PIAC operations: trusted principal/session/tenant/consent/entitlement only; no business truth. SOV Runtime: PIAC decision + SOV resource/precondition guard; denial/revocation/stale evidence fails closed. SOV personal tracking: personal subject ownership/purpose + exact source binding + SOV guard. Arcava client/coaching operations: PIAC actor/tenant/consent/entitlement + Arcava CoachAssignment/enrollment/resource/commercial/booking guard as applicable. KDB candidate/review/publish: PIAC/service identity + KDB purpose/rights/reviewer/publisher/lifecycle/validation guard. Provider callback: verified provider origin + owner-local adapter guard + replay/idempotency checks. No generic platform role bypasses an owner-domain guard.

ProviderPermission, ConsentDecision, ActivityShareGrant, CoachAssignment, EntitlementDecision, tenant membership and resource ownership are independent controls. Each has stable identity, policy/version, effective_at, expiry/revocation where applicable and evidence. Missing, expired, revoked or stale gate is DENY/REVOKED/STALE; no gate is inferred from another. Withdrawal/revocation affects future access and owner-local projections; immutable historical evidence is not rewritten.

Repo A shared_core: PIAC migration owner, PIAC runtime/service identity, audit reader; RLS/default deny for subject/tenant scoped data; no Arcava/KDB table privileges. Repo A sov_runtime: SOV runtime/personal-tracking service identities scoped to SOV operations; direct cross-owner access denied. Repo B arcava: Arcava application/provider-adapter/composition services scoped to tenant/resource/assignment/business guards; no KDB canonical or SOV mutation. Repo B KDB lane: KDB migration owner, pipeline service, reviewer, publisher, read service and audit reader separated; no Arcava/SOV direct table access. PUBLIC/anon privileged mutation denied. SECURITY INVOKER preferred. SECURITY DEFINER only when justified, with dedicated NOLOGIN/NOSUPERUSER/NOBYPASSRLS owner, minimal grants, fixed minimal search_path and schema-qualified references. Cross-owner FK cascades and grants are forbidden.

S00 authenticated server context: verified PIAC principal/session/tenant/audience/issuer + decision/purpose/resource + freshness; request body/GUC alone grants nothing. S01 tenant + subject/client membership; coach active assignment/resource; admin config authority distinct sensitive access. S02 consent/share/provider permission/entitlement/enrollment/business guards independently current. S03 default-deny RLS/ACL, explicit service scope; no browser bypass role. S04 publication/correction/effect immutability and revision checks. S05 current rights/safety/source/pack admission and human digest approval. S06 minimized events/logs/projections and redaction/erasure/tombstones. S07 authenticated idempotent callbacks, provider-key UNKNOWN fence. S08 owner-only migration/roles/fixed search_path/evidence.

Client/coach/admin operations on Programme/Journey, enrollment, client resources, tracking/progress, communications/media, Client360/Timeline/Attention, Appointment/booking/reschedule/cancel/no-show, ReminderPlan, composition and commercial guards require PIAC actor/session/tenant evidence plus Arcava resource/assignment/business guard. Provider operations additionally require ProviderPermission and relevant owner-local grant. Sensitive activity views require ConsentDecision + ActivityShareGrant + CoachAssignment where applicable.

ProviderPermission, ConsentDecision, ActivityShareGrant, CoachAssignment, EntitlementDecision and tenant membership are independent gates. Missing/revoked/expired/stale gate fails closed. Client360/Timeline are minimized projections, not universal ledgers. Private reflections and communications are excluded from generic cross-lane events. Provider activity missing data is UNKNOWN, never zero. Export/erasure/redaction follow resource ownership and retention policy; exact legal retention durations remain TBD where sources do not define them.

GATE-RECORD: GATE_ID, PARENT_PLAN_ID, PARENT_STEP, OWNER, GATE_TYPE, BLOCKED_SCOPE, MISSING_CRITERION, CLOSURE_CRITERIA, EVIDENCE_REQUIRED, NEXT_EXECUTOR, NEXT_ACTION, REVIEW_TRIGGER, STATUS und bei Bedarf BLOCKER_ID. Owner ist verantwortlich, ein benannter externer Löser dadurch noch nicht beauftragt. Rollen-/Zugriffslücken offen als UNASSIGNED/UNVERIFIED markieren. Existierende IDs und Ablage wiederverwenden.

GESCHACHTELTER PLAN NUR BEI BEDARF: Ein direkt lösbares Gate benötigt keinen Unterplan. Braucht die Lösung mehrere abhängige Schritte, legt der Builder im bestehenden Owner-Dokument einen begrenzten Gate-Unterplan/Zwischensprint an. CHILD_PLAN_ID verweist eindeutig auf PARENT_PLAN_ID/PARENT_STEP und TARGET_GATE_ID. Zweck, Eingangszustand, konkrete Schritte/Ergebnisse, Abhängigkeiten, zulässige Operationen, Abnahmekriterien und Rückkehrpunkt werden festgehalten. Schrittzahl nach Bedarf, keine erzwungenen zehn Schritte für ein kleines Problem. Weitere Verschachtelung nur für eine tatsächliche eigenständige Abhängigkeit und mit Begründung; so flach wie möglich.

SCHLIESSUNG UND RUECKKEHR: Executor liefert exakten Source-/Versions-/Testnachweis und verbleibende Lücken. Builder prüft einmal das relevante Delta; unabhängige QS nur wo risikobedingt erforderlich. GELOEST/CLOSED gilt ausschließlich für erfüllte benannte Kriterien und Scope. Technischer Erfolg, Owner-Abnahme und Produktionszulassung getrennt halten. Child-Abschluss aktualisiert Parent-Checkpoint und Gate-/Blockerrecord; danach am dokumentierten RETURN_TO fortsetzen, ursprünglichen Meilenstein nicht überspringen oder neu beginnen. PENDING_REVIEW ist nicht CLOSED. Keine künstlichen Evidence-only-Commit-Schleifen oder Routine-QS ohne materielles Delta.
